candidates.reason: The ONLINE ONLY, LIMITED RUN and NEW badges float as loose pieces between the logo and the jar with no shared alignment, and LIMITED RUN looks stretched and pixelated. 'Swipe up to shop' is squeezed into a tiny three-line column jammed beside the CTA. The jar circle sits low-left, leaving the upper-left awkwardly busy and the composition lopsided.

Same layout as candidate 1 and the same problems: the three badges are scattered, unaligned fragments cut off from the product. 'Swipe up to shop' is a cramped three-line sliver next to the CTA. The headline, copy and CTA in the right column don't share a clean edge. The only improvement is that the LIMITED RUN badge keeps its proportions.

The original's vertical layout is placed unchanged in the centre of the square, with no rearranging. Large empty side areas waste the format. The body copy, the NEW and LIMITED RUN badges and 'Swipe up to shop' stay small at this size. It is coherent, on brand and collision-free, but reads as padding rather than a redesign.

A real two-column redesign: the jar is on the left and the headline, copy and CTA flow down the right, with the CTA strongly prominent. However, the rotated ONLINE ONLY badge crowds into LIMITED RUN, and the oversized badge row competes with the CTA. 'Swipe up to shop' is promoted and placed before the badges and CTA, which breaks the reading order. The SOLSTICE logo is demoted to an off-axis spot at the bottom that aligns with neither column.
